name: Austral-Reliquary
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near orbital debris ring.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
